verdict.rationale: Docs claim Claude will auto-invoke skills 'when relevant' based on natural-language context, in addition to explicit `/skill-name` commands (anthropic-skills-docs-2, -25, -34), which directly supports natural-language operation. However, hands-on community reports concretely contradict reliability of this auto-triggering: Vercel's eval found skills were never invoked in 56% of cases despite being relevant, and multiple users report skills are 'hit or miss' or 'incredibly hard' to get triggered via natural language alone, sometimes requiring explicit prompting to use a named skill (anthropic-skills-comm-7, -8, -9). Missing for 10: independent benchmark showing reliable natural-language triggering, and resolution of the documented invocation-failure reports.
